'''Toshdor Ni''' was a towering [[Lorrdian]] [[Gender|male]] member of the [[Brotherhood of the Beatific Countenance]] who took a vow of silence and used heavy concealing [[Clothing|robes]] to try and hide his [[species]]' natural expressiveness. He and other members of the Brotherhood made a [[pilgrim]]age to [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. In [[1 BBY]], he was present in one of the markets of the [[city]] shortly before it was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].

==Biography==
[[File:KilliToshdor-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|Toshdor Ni (left) visited Jedha City on a pilgrimage.]]
Toshdor Ni was a [[Lorrdian]] [[Gender|male]] member of the [[Brotherhood of the Beatific Countenance]] who took a vow of silence<ref name="Visual Guide" /> alongside those who followed him.<ref name="Topps" /> He and other members of the Brotherhood<ref name="Visual Guide" /> led by [[the High Priest]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> made a [[pilgrim]]age to [[Jedha City]] on the sacred [[moon]] [[Jedha]].<ref name="Visual Guide" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Ni walked through one of the [[city]]'s markets alone and then later walked alongside<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> the [[Disciples of the Whills|Disciple of the Whills]] [[Killi Gimm]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> and the [[Partisans|partisan]] [[Joali Andit]]<ref name="Dawn">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> while trailed by another member of the Brotherhood as the group passed between rows of market stalls. Shortly afterward, the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] Jedha City with the [[Mk I Superlaser|superlaser]] of its [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="RO" />

==Personality and traits==
Toshdor Ni was a spiritual truth seeker who traveled far and wide in search of answers to deep, metaphysical questions. Despite his vow of silence, Ni's formidable stance and body [[language]] often did the talking for him<ref name="Topps" /> as all Lorrdians possessed a marked expression, as well as a natural odor. He used his [[clothing]] to conceal this expression and respect his vow,<ref name="Geektionary" /> although it did not completely hide the natural expressiveness of his stance and movements.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Skills and abilities==
Toshdor Ni had far above average intelligence and was slightly [[Force-sensitive]] but had slightly below average strength and speed and far below average [[diplomat]]ic skills and fighting abilities.<ref name="Topps" />

==Equipment==
Toshdor Ni wore the heavy fabric vestments of the Brotherhood with the concealing [[Color|vermilion]] and yellow [[robe]]s acting as a physical vow of silence. They were permeated with the smoke of the [[Qatameric incense]] that he burned in a [[metal]]lic [[staff]]-mounted [[censer]] that he carried, masking the Lorrdian's natural scent.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JedhaExtrasVersion7C.png|thumb|right|260px|"Jedha Extra Version 7C" by Adam Brockbank]]
Toshdor Ni was created for the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="RO" /> Prior to the film's release on [[December 16]], [[2016]], the character was first depicted in the second story trailer for ''Rogue One'', which was released on [[October 13]], 2016.<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|sC9abcLLQpI|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Trailer #2 (Official)|sw_url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-trailer-2}}</ref> The character was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> and released on the same day as the film.<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/rebel-reading-rogue-one-books|text=Rebel Reading: A Guide to ''Rogue One'' Books|author=[[James Floyd|Floyd, James]]|date=2016-12-14}}</ref>

The character's name appears to be a partial [[tuckerization]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> of the name of [[Rodney Tosh]], one of the film's stunt performers who portrayed one of the Lorrdians in the film.<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://wrestlingjunkies.wixsite.com/wrestlingjunkies/rodney-tosh-interview|text=Rodney Tosh Interview - Star Wars Rogue One|author=Lorenz, Bernd|date=2020-03-22|work=[https://wrestlingjunkies.wixsite.com/wrestlingjunkies The Entertainment Junkie]|archivedate=20230607082533}}</ref> Concept art of the costume worn by Ni and other members of the Brotherhood titled "Jedha Extra Version 7C" was drawn by costume concept artist [[Adam Brockbank]].<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
